editorialSummary.heading: Monday pickup starts with the first day of school
highlights: Every instructional Monday ends early, including August 10 and November 30
Strawberry Festival holiday moved to March 8; March 1 remains a school Monday
Six hurricane reserves may shorten planned time off
paragraphs: The first day lands on Monday, August 10, so Hillsborough’s weekly early-release rule starts immediately. Students also return from Fall Break on a shortened Monday, November 30. Full student holidays take precedence over that weekly pattern. The final Friday, May 28, has its own dismissal rule: students leave two and a half hours early. Check your school’s bell times; a Monday dismissal and the last-day dismissal are not interchangeable.

The March 24 update moves the Strawberry Festival non-student day from March 1 to March 8. March 1 remains an instructional Monday. The Florida State Fair holiday falls on Friday, February 12, followed by Presidents Day on Monday, February 15, giving families four consecutive days without classes. Spring Break is March 22-26, with a separate non-student day March 29 and a Tuesday, March 30 return.

Fall Break covers November 23-27, but November 23-25 may be needed for hurricane make-up. October 12, Veterans Day on November 11 and January 4 are also reserves. Winter Break itself ends January 1; January 4 is a separate non-student day before the scheduled January 5 return. Recheck those reserve dates before booking travel.

First day August 10 and return November 30 each remain one canonical occurrence with both meanings. Do not expand the rule over any published full non-student day, including conditional reserves. October 12, November 11 and January 4 are the other conditional reserves. Their no-class status describes the published baseline; no absolute attendance flag is assigned. Riverview bell row applies only from September 10; its page explicitly retires the older schedule. Bell-table a.m./p.m. follows the published period sequence. faqs.question: When does school start in Hillsborough County for 2026-2027?
faqs.answer: Students start Monday, August 10, 2026. The first day follows the Monday early-release rule, so arrange pickup for your school’s shortened schedule.

faqs.question: Does Hillsborough have early release every Monday in 2026-2027?
faqs.answer: Yes, on Mondays when students have classes. The published schedule works out to 31 instructional Mondays. A full non-student day remains a day off unless the district activates it for hurricane make-up. November 30, the return from Fall Break, is an early-release Monday.

faqs.question: What time does my child get out on early-release Mondays?
faqs.answer: Ask your school for its bell schedule. Riverview High’s schedule effective September 10, 2026 runs 8:30 a.m.-2:35 p.m. on instructional Mondays and 8:30 a.m.-3:35 p.m. Tuesday-Friday. Those times apply to Riverview High only. The district calendar does not give one Monday dismissal time for every school.

faqs.question: When is the last day of school, and how early do students leave?
faqs.answer: The last day is Friday, May 28, 2027. Students leave 2 hours and 30 minutes before their regular dismissal time. It also ends the fourth grading period and second semester; use your school’s last-day instructions for the pickup time.

faqs.question: When is Thanksgiving break for Hillsborough schools in 2026?
faqs.answer: The district calls it Fall Break: November 23-27, 2026, with students returning Monday, November 30. November 23, 24 and 25 are tentative hurricane make-up days. The full break applies if those reserves are not used; November 26-27 are not listed as reserves.

faqs.question: When is winter break, and do students return January 4?
faqs.answer: Winter Break runs December 21, 2026-January 1, 2027. January 4 is a separate non-student day, also reserved for possible hurricane make-up. The printed student return is Tuesday, January 5. January 4 could become a school day if the district uses that reserve.

faqs.question: When is spring break, and is March 29 a school day?
faqs.answer: Spring Break is March 22-26, 2027. Monday, March 29 is a separate non-student day, and students return Tuesday, March 30. Including the surrounding weekends and that Monday, the scheduled time away from classes runs March 20-29.

faqs.question: Which Hillsborough dates are reserved for hurricane make-up in 2026-2027?
faqs.answer: The PDF lists October 12, November 11, November 23-25, 2026 and January 4, 2027. All six are currently planned without student classes but may become attendance days if needed. Check district announcements before treating them as guaranteed travel days.

faqs.question: Did the Strawberry Festival school holiday move from March 1?
faqs.answer: Yes. The March 24 calendar update moves it from March 1 to Monday, March 8, 2027. Students have no classes March 8. March 1 remains a scheduled school Monday with early release.

faqs.question: Do students have school for the Florida State Fair or Presidents Day?
faqs.answer: Students are off Friday, February 12, 2027 for the Florida State Fair and Monday, February 15 for Presidents Day. Together with the weekend, that makes four consecutive days off, February 12-15. Classes resume Tuesday, February 16.

faqs.question: Are Labor Day, Veterans Day and Martin Luther King Jr. Day days off?
faqs.answer: Labor Day, September 7, 2026 and Martin Luther King Jr. Day, January 18, 2027 are fixed non-student holidays. Veterans Day, November 11, is also scheduled without classes but is a tentative hurricane make-up date.

faqs.question: Is October 12, 2026 a student day?
faqs.answer: It is listed as a non-student day and a tentative hurricane make-up date. Students have no classes under the published schedule unless the district activates it. October 9 is the first grading-period end and remains a scheduled school day.

faqs.question: Is there a school holiday on April 16, 2027?
faqs.answer: Students have no classes Friday, April 16. The district labels it Non-Student Day without naming a holiday. With the weekend, students are off April 16-18 and are scheduled back Monday, April 19, an early-release day.

faqs.question: When do the grading periods and semesters end?
faqs.answer: The four grading periods end October 9 and December 18, 2026, then March 12 and May 28, 2027. The first semester ends December 18; the second ends May 28. Only May 28 has a shortened schedule among those four dates in this calendar. Grading-period ends are not report-card release dates.

faqs.question: How many student days are in the Hillsborough 2026-2027 calendar?
faqs.answer: The published schedule yields 180 planned attendance weekdays: 210 weekdays from August 10 through May 28, minus 24 fixed no-school weekdays and six currently unused hurricane reserves. This is calculated from the dates, not an annual total printed in the PDF. Later closures or make-up decisions may change attendance.

faqs.question: Where can I download the official Hillsborough calendar and add the dates to my phone?
faqs.answer: Use the official 2026-2027 PDF download on this page or the district’s Student Academic Calendar document page. The calendar file on this page can be imported into Google Calendar or Apple Calendar. Check the district’s notices for changes after importing a saved copy.

faqs.question: What is the first day of school in Hillsborough County for 2027-2028?
faqs.answer: Students begin Tuesday, August 10, 2027. The calendar does not identify the first day as an early-release day. Check your school’s arrival and dismissal instructions before the year starts.

faqs.question: Will Hillsborough schools release early every Monday in 2027-2028?
faqs.answer: That has not been finalized in the approved PDF. It specifically says Monday, August 16, 2027 is a regular student day with no early release. Do not assume the 2026-2027 Monday schedule will continue. The confirmed last-day early release is a separate rule.

faqs.question: When is the last day of school in Hillsborough for 2028?
faqs.answer: Friday, May 26, 2028 is the last day, with dismissal 2 hours and 30 minutes earlier than the regular school day. It also ends the fourth grading period and second semester. Confirm the actual pickup time with your school.

faqs.question: When is Hillsborough’s Thanksgiving break in 2027?
faqs.answer: Fall Break runs November 22-26, 2027, with a scheduled return Monday, November 29. November 22-24 are tentative hurricane make-up dates; November 25-26 are not listed as reserves. The Monday-Wednesday portion may become school days if needed.

faqs.question: How long is winter break, and when do classes resume in January 2028?
faqs.answer: The named Winter Break is December 20-31, 2027. Monday, January 3 is a separate non-student day and a hurricane make-up reserve. Students are scheduled to return Tuesday, January 4. If January 3 is activated, attendance could resume a day earlier.

faqs.question: When is spring break in Hillsborough County in 2028?
faqs.answer: Spring Break is March 13-17, 2028. Monday, March 20 is also a non-student day, listed separately. Students return Tuesday, March 21. Including the two weekends and that extra Monday, the scheduled time without classes runs March 11-20.

faqs.question: What are the hurricane make-up dates in the 2027-2028 calendar?
faqs.answer: The tentative dates are November 11, November 22-24, 2027 and January 3, 2028. All five are currently scheduled without classes but may be used for attendance if needed. Watch district announcements before finalizing travel on those dates.

faqs.question: Do Hillsborough students get a day off for the Florida State Fair in 2028?
faqs.answer: Yes. Friday, February 18 is the Florida State Fair non-student day. Presidents Day on Monday, February 21 is also off, making February 18-21 a four-day weekend. Students are scheduled back Tuesday, February 22.

faqs.question: When is the Strawberry Festival school holiday in 2028?
faqs.answer: Monday, March 6, 2028 is the Strawberry Festival non-student day. It is separate from Spring Break, which starts March 13. March 7-10 remain scheduled school days, with the third grading period ending March 10.

faqs.question: Are Labor Day, Veterans Day and Martin Luther King Jr. Day school holidays?
faqs.answer: Students have no classes on Labor Day, September 6, 2027 and Martin Luther King Jr. Day, January 17, 2028. Veterans Day, November 11, is a planned non-student holiday that may be used for hurricane make-up.

faqs.question: Is there an October teacher workday after the first grading period?
faqs.answer: The 2027-2028 student calendar does not list an October non-student day. The first grading period ends Friday, October 8, 2027. Do not carry over October 12 from the previous year’s calendar.

faqs.question: Are Hillsborough schools closed to students on April 14, 2028?
faqs.answer: Yes. Friday, April 14 is a non-student day. The PDF does not give it a holiday name. Students have a three-day weekend April 14-16 and are scheduled to return Monday, April 17; that return date is inferred from the published schedule.

faqs.question: When do Hillsborough grading periods and semesters end in 2027-2028?
faqs.answer: Grading periods end October 8 and December 17, 2027, then March 10 and May 26, 2028. Semester one ends December 17; semester two ends May 26. May 26 is confirmed as an early release. The other grading ends are not separately listed as shortened days, and report-card distribution dates are not provided.

faqs.question: How many school days does the 2027-2028 Hillsborough schedule contain?
faqs.answer: The listed dates produce a baseline of 180 attendance weekdays: 209 weekdays from August 10 through May 26, less 24 fixed no-school weekdays and five unused hurricane reserves. This is a calculation, not a printed annual total. Later closures and make-up decisions can change the operating schedule.

faqs.question: Are school start times and dismissal times available for 2027-2028?
faqs.answer: The annual calendar does not publish campus bell times, and its early-release schedule is still pending. Confirm hours with your child’s school when its 2027-2028 schedule is released. Riverview High’s verified 2026-2027 timetable should not be used as next year’s bell schedule.
